## {{< iconify octicon:people-24 aria-hidden=true >}} Teaching & Workshops {#teaching}

[I]{.drop-cap} teach R and Quarto, with pre-configured Dev Container templates so that participants spend the session working rather than installing.
Existing material includes the two-day [Mastering Quarto CLI](https://github.com/mcanouil/mastering-quarto-cli) workshop, [R Advanced](https://github.com/mcanouil/radvanced), [Shiny: First Steps](https://github.com/mcanouil/rshiny), [R Packages](https://github.com/mcanouil/rpackages), and [R and Databases](https://github.com/mcanouil/rdatabase).
Recent talks include *Introduction to Development Containers* and *A Gentle Introduction to Quarto*.
